label: the salt pan outpost
note: Issue #187: one of the Remnant's four outposts on the far sides of the town (the first three, near/mid/far, are out the front gate). Same pieces as remnant_outpost_mid.json (see its note): a building dressed by src/systems/world/remnant_outposts.gd, a ship at 'ship', three troopers at guard_a/b/c, an assassin droid on 'patrol', a floating droid on 'floater', a cargo droid on 'cargo', and the bounty target at 'target'. Local frame: +x faces the town. Issue #309: 'room' makes the block a control room you can walk into (src/systems/world/outpost_room.gd): walls, a roof and a doorway in its +x face on the same footprint, consoles, a holo table and the hack console Heist opens (content/core/story/heist.json). guard_c stands inside, at the consoles with his back to the door.

zone.note: Issue #308: a ring of radius metres round the outpost is a checkpoint zone. Below the wave band the nearest trooper (a role below) who sees you walks up and the gate's card opens, on the gate's rules (content/core/soldiers/gate_guard.json checkpoint block; anything in this checkpoint block wins). Leave the ring and the card closes; cleared, the outpost leaves you alone for cleared_s.
